payload.query: Which colours go well with navy?

args.text: Navy pairs well with white, grey, beige, tan, olive, and brown [color-matching#2]. A classic smart casual combination is navy with tan or brown leather [color-matching#2]. Additionally, navy can be worn with black if there is a clear difference in shade, though the pairing looks best when a light color, such as a white shirt, is placed between them [color-matching#2].
